meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 经 Chat SDK 桥接接入 GitHub:参与 PR 和 issue 评论,被 @ 时回复;首次被 @ 后订阅该评论线程,后续评论也会自动回复。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 GitHub 接入为聊天频道时触发;前提是准备一个专用的 GitHub 机器人账号(非个人账号)。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 频道接进来,让机器人能回 PR 评论。
say.note: 会开始复制 GitHub 适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 接入 GitHub 时用专用机器人账号,别用我个人的。
say.note: 会按要求使用 bot 账号继续。

say.text: 给 GitHub 配置 webhook 和访问令牌。
say.note: 会提示粘贴 token、webhook 密钥和用户名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude bridges GitHub via the Chat SDK: it participates in PR and issue comment threads, replies when @-mentioned, and after the first mention subscribes to the thread and auto-replies to follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add GitHub as a chat channel. Requires a dedicated GitHub bot account, not a personal one.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel so the bot can reply to PR comments.
say_en.note: Starts copying the GitHub adapter and walks through setup.

say_en.text: Use a dedicated bot account for GitHub, not my personal one.
say_en.note: Uses the bot account as required.

say_en.text: Set up the GitHub webhook and access token.
say_en.note: Prompts for token, webhook secret, and username.
